indexFields.characteristic: 简单发育后就能具有独当一面的实力。
indexFields.biography: 凌操，凌统之父，其人“轻便有胆气”。早年跟随孙策转战江东。每从征伐，常奋勇当先。驻守永平（今江苏溧阳），平治山越，百姓威服，迁为破贼校尉。建安八年（203年）十一月，从孙权西伐江夏黄祖，凌操轻舟当先，杀入夏口，破敌前锋，却不幸被甘宁射杀

skills.name: 独进
skills.text: 摸牌阶段，你可以多摸X+1张牌（X为装备区里的牌数的一半且向上取整）。
skills.mapping: optional drawPhaseStarting owner trigger; one owner draw using equipmentHalfCeilingPlusOne
notes: Count actual public cards in the owner's equipment zone, including expanded equipment slots. Zero equipment still grants one extra card.
Compute the count once before one DrawCards call. A gained-card child changing equipment cannot reevaluate another threshold and duplicate the completed instruction.
The AI uses the same public equipment card count; no opponent hand identities or counts are added to the context.

observations: The official frontend uses initial_hp only when nonzero and otherwise renders hp filled hearts. initial_hp 0 therefore means no initial-health override; the page's og:description '0体力' is an inconsistent metadata rendering, not the game health.
The 2023-12-29 official announcement explicitly lists 吴, 4, 男 and the same 独进 text.

The independent 一将成名 凌操 at https://x.sanguosha.com/hero/1225.html and the 2024-10-22 announcement at https://www.sanguosha.com/news/20241022_6356_4017 use 独锋 and are excluded from this current OL hero/598 record.
